_comment: Regions in expectOk are verified-working camera APIs (probe run 2026-07-10) — the scheduled endpoint-health workflow fails (and opens an issue) if any of them stop serving cameras. Regions NOT listed are broken registry entries probed report-only; promote them here once scripts/probe-endpoints.mjs shows them working.

notes.SK,MB,NB,NS,PE,NL,YT,NY,PA,CT,GA,FL,WI,L: CONFIRMED by probe: IBI 511 API returns HTTP 400 {"Message":"Invalid Key"} — these deployments require a registered API key (AB and ON don't enforce one). Fix: register for per-state 511 developer keys and have the cors-proxy Worker inject them server-side so they aren't shipped in client JS.
notes.OH: CONFIRMED: publicapi.ohgo.com returns 401 'API key required.' — docs at https://publicapi.ohgo.com/docs/resources
notes.NJ: 511nj.org returns 403 Access Denied to non-browser requests
notes.MN,IA,NE,CO,MA,IN,KS: endpoints serve an SPA index page — these states migrated off the IBI api/v2 platform
notes.WY,MT,MO,MS,SD,NM: 404 — endpoint URLs are dead and need rediscovery
notes.OK: oktraffic.org IS a live API server (LoopBack-style error: 'no method to handle GET /v2/get/cameras') — correct route needs rediscovery
notes.IL: gettingaroundillinois.com: resource removed/renamed (404 with IIS message)
notes.QC: Quebec WFS returns HTTP 400 with an OWS ExceptionReport — query parameters need rechecking
notes.SC,VA,TN,AL,AR: serve HTML pages, not the IBI JSON API
notes.DE: working, but cameras expose only RTMP/RTSP/M3U8 video streams — no static images exist; showing them needs HLS video support in the camera card/modal
notes.OR,MD,ND,KY: working but normalizers map no image URLs — check the probe's 'raw fields' note (full key dump) to fix the field mapping or confirm the source is video-only
